svg.text: Figure 3-1 · Who does what (RACI), and who holds each role today
§3.2 grid; above each column its holder from §3.1. The last column asks whether the review, audit or assessment the activity needs has a named person who is not its author
6 of 10 roles are held by Jherrod Thomas; 12 of 14 activities need a review, audit or assessment by someone not yet named. One person may hold several roles, but not review their own work (§3.1).
